    for (int i = start; i < (int)s.size(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == sub[0]) {
            bool ok = true;
            for (int j = 1; j < (int)sub.size(); j++) {

            }
            if (ok) return i;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

string process(const string& s, int last) {
    int i = my_find(s, "dot", max(last, 1));
    if (i == -1 || i >= (int)s.size() - 3) {
        return s.substr(last);
    }
    return s.substr(last, i - last) + "." + process(s, i + 3);
}

    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int atPos = my_find(s, "at", 1);
    string s2 = s.substr(0, atPos) + '@' + s.substr(atPos + 2);
